verses.text: Ha winhaj Moisés yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix halan juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a masanil heb' chonhab': Ha tikne'ik, ol he k'anab'ajej masanil tas skalkan tik t'ayex.

Ayik ol ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán yik ol ex och t'a sat lum lum te yax sat ol yak' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayex, icha ajnak yak'an sti' t'a heb' ko mam kicham, tze b'okank'e juntzanh k'e'en niwak k'e'en t'a yich lum witz Ebal, tzeyak'anoch k'e'en ta'anh t'a k'e'en. Tze tz'ib'ankanoch masanil juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al swalkan tik t'ayex t'a k'e'en. Tze k'ulej jun tik ayik ayexxoek' ta'.

Tze b'oanpaxk'e junok altar t'a Jehová ko Diosal. Ha k'e'en k'e'en tzeyak'och chi' t'ay, manh he mak'poj k'e'en, manh he tzeypax tojolb'ok k'e'en. Ha t'a yib'anh jun altar chi' tze nhustz'a silab' t'a Jehová ko Diosal.
Tzeyak'anpax silab' sch'oxan he junk'olal yet' ko Diosal chi'. Hata' tzex wa t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

B'at ta satk'olal eyuj he tz'ib'ankanoch masanil juntzanh cheknab'il swalkan tik t'ayex t'a juntzanh k'e'en b'aj ol eyak'och k'e'en ta'anh chi'. Te wach' tzeyutej he tz'ib'ankanochi yik chekel, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ha winhaj Moisés, ajun heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví yet'nak winh, ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' chonhab' chi' icha tik: Ex wetisraelal, numan tzex aji, ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ha tikne'ik toxo onh och wal schonhab'ok Jehová ko Diosal.
Yuj chi' yowalil tze k'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il yet' juntzanh sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová swalkanel tik t'ayex, xchi winh.
Hanhejtona' t'a jun k'u chi' ix yalpax jun cheknab'il tik winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi':
Ayik toxo ex k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán, a heb' yinhtilalkan Simeón, Leví, Judá, Isacar, José yet' Benjamín, tz'aj heb' t'a yich witz Gerizim, yik syal wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab'.
Haxo pax heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén, Gad, Aser, Zabulón, Dan yet' Neftalí, tz'aj heb' t'a yich lum witz Ebal yik syalan katab' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' chonhab'.
Haxo heb' yinhtilal Leví, te cha'anh syal juntzanh lolonel tik heb' t'a heb' yetisraelal icha tik:

katab'il mach sb'o'an junok yechel komon Dios t'a te te', ma t'a k'e'en k'e'en, syak'anoch t'a junok lugar k'ub'eltak yik tz'och ejmelal t'ay. Ha juntzanh chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach malaj yelk'och smam snun t'a yol sat, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach sk'exan stz'akanhil slu'um yik stok'ek' slu'um junokxo mach, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach tz'ak'an musansatil junok anima max ujilaj yilani, haxo t'a ch'ok b'eal schekkanb'ati, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.

katab'il mach sk'ulan tas manh tojolok t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, t'a heb' unin manhxa smam, ma t'a heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam, yujto a mach sk'ulan icha chi', syak' k'ixwelal smam chi', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' nok' nok', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' schab'il yanab', yanab' yuj smam ma yuj snun, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smulan yet' ix snhi', xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach smak'ancham junok yetanima'il t'a elk'altak, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach scha'an tumin yik smak'ancham junok anima malaj smul, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
katab'il mach max k'anab'ajan masanil scheknab'il Dios, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' chonhab' chi' tz'alani: Ujokab'i, xcham heb'.
